name: unmassk-trading
description: Conversational trading on Kraken, with two modes. Beginner mode interrogates what the user actually knows, teaches at that level, and starts them on a local paper account before a euro moves. Advanced mode goes straight to execution. The user gives every order; the skill never trades on its own and never holds a withdrawal-capable key. Hard gates: --validate before every live order, dead man's switch per session, two-source price cross-check, and every quote stamped with its age. Advice is arithmetic and facts (position size, risk in euros, levels, contradictions against the user's own record) — never a direction call.
